corrected_code:
from ninja import Router
from ninja.security import HttpBearer
from ninja.errors import HttpError
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from django.contrib.auth.models import Group
from waffle.models import Flag

waffle_admin_router = Router(auth=HttpBearer())

@waffle_admin_router.post("/waffle/flags/{flag_name}/groups/{group_id}")
def add_group_to_feature_flag(request, flag_name: str, group_id: int):
    if not request.auth.is_staff or not request.auth.has_perm('waffle.change_flag'):
        raise HttpError(403, "Administrator privileges required to modify feature flag groups")

    flag = get_object_or_404(Flag, name=flag_name)
    group = get_object_or_404(Group, id=group_id)

    flag.groups.add(group)
    return {"status": "group_linked", "flag": flag.name, "group": group.name}
